Long time no see!
I just remembered, I forgot to
teach you about <color=#A61FFF>Skills</color>.

If you haven't figured it out yet,
you can use your <color=#A61FFF>Skill</color> with <color=#FCC926>Mouse Right</color>.

You can inspect your <color=#A61FFF>Skill</color>
in the <color=#FCC926>Character Panel</color>.
Remember, you can open it with <color=#FCC926>[C]</color>.

While <color=#26B0FF>Per Room</color> and <color=#26B0FF>Per Second</color>
are quite self explanatory,
<color=#26B0FF>Per Enemy</color> generates <color=#26B0FF>Mana<sprite name=Mana></color> as you
inflict damage to an Enemy.

If you ever wonder what aspects of your <color=#A61FFF>Skill</color>
are influenced by the <color=#A61FFF>Skill Effect</color> Stat,
make sure to check if the <sprite name="Skill"> <color=#00E61A>Icon</color>
is next to the value.

Bosses count as multiple Enemies,
so you can generate more <color=#26B0FF>Mana<sprite name=Mana></color>
when fighting against them.

Every class has a different <color=#A61FFF>Skill</color> and
<color=#A61FFF>Skills</color> come in a variety of
shapes and forms.

For example:
<color=#A61FFF>Skills</color> can have 3 different kinds
of <color=#26B0FF>Mana Recovery<sprite name=Mana></color>.
